NewsArticle.Title: Server Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: - 10.23 23:40 PDT Dark Ages server underwent routine maintenance. It was in maintenance through 00:16. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, [test your connection.](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm)
